_narrative_provider_options: auto (Gemini when .env has NARRATIVE_PROVIDER=gemini and a key, else manual) | manual (only read narrative.json you paste in; no network calls) | gemini. A saved narrative.json is always reused; delete it to have Gemini write a new one.
_ai_research_options: auto (tavily when .env has TAVILY_API_KEY, else sector_only) | tavily (Tavily web search + Gemini reads it; free keys work) | gemini (Gemini's own Google Search; needs a paid Gemini key) | sector_only (blank Sectors only, no web search) | off. Fills blank Sector, Result Line and Management Commentary for the held stocks; never a value CREST typed.
_ai_max_requests_per_run_note: Gemini requests per client run, research and ratings/narrative together. One is always kept for the ratings + narrative request; research batches use the rest.
_ai_research_retry_days_note: A stock whose results were not out yet is searched again after this many days.
_rating_provider_options: auto (Gemini rates blank Rating/Sentiment when .env has a key, else the draft rules if approved) | gemini | rules. A value typed in the Universal Sheet always wins. Views always come from the Universal Sheet only.
